preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each test case must have an array length n between 3 and 200,000.
The total length of arrays across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of operations m, followed by m pairs of indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in operations)
postconditions.description: All operations must use valid indices x and y within the bounds of the array and must be distinct.
The number of operations m must not exceed n + 5.
The final array state must consist of n-1 ones and 1 two.
postconditions.expression: sum(1 for x in a if x == 1) == n - 1 and sum(1 for x in a if x == 2) == 1
